subject: BrightSupply: competitive bakeoff — response & save plan
messages:
From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@brightsupply.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@brightsupply.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightSupply evaluation: quick request + test plan (competitive bakeoff)

Markus,

Thanks for jumping on this quickly. We’ve started a formal bakeoff across two vendors (Redwood and Nimbus AI) and need a concise response from Redwood covering:

- Target latency percentiles for a 2k concurrent session workload (token lengths ~256)
- Expected cost per 1M tokens for the recommended config
- Any support/commitments you can make for a short trial (we need procurement-friendly terms)

I attached the test plan we’ll run and a sample corpus. Nimbus has already provided a price that’s aggressive on list rate, so we’ll be comparing price+observed perf.

Can we get an initial reply today and a proposed trial schedule? Procurement wants a procurement_timeline.pdf attached (we’ll share our timeline separately).

Thanks — Ethan
Ethan Miller
VP of Product
BrightSupply

Attachments: brightsupply-bakeoff-test-plan.pdf (PDF), sample_corpus.zip (attachment)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@brightsupply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightSupply evaluation: quick request + test plan (competitive bakeoff)

Ethan — thanks for the details and the test plan. Quick replies inline:  

- Latency: for a 2k concurrent session profile (256-token avg) our recommended config (Redwood-v2-quant, dedicated pool) targets p50 ~35–50ms, p95 ~200–300ms depending on batching and sequence distribution. We'll provide a short benchmark report with identical load.
- Cost: ballpark 1M tokens ~ $X (I'll include a procurement-ready quote after we finalize the config and trial duration).
- Trial: we can stand up a 2-week dedicated trial on a reserved pool (no shared noisy neighbors) and run your test plan end-to-end. We can provide extra SRE support during the trial window.

I’ve attached a proposed test-run sheet (redwood-proposed-test-run-sheet.xlsx) with the exact load profile we suggest. Marissa/Neha/Dylan are looped in to scope the trial and review security/compliance constraints.

Suggested next step: 30-minute sync Monday to lock the trial window and get procurement what it needs. What times work for you?

—Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-proposed-test-run-sheet.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@brightsupply.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@brightsupply.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightSupply evaluation: quick request + test plan (competitive bakeoff)

Markus — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications before Monday:  

1) Procurement asked for an explicit SLA target for p95 latency during the trial (they're sensitive to tail latency). Can Redwood commit to a 250ms p95 for the trial window on the dedicated pool?
2) For cost comparisons we need a clear total-cost-of-ownership estimate: list rate, any launch discounts, and estimated overage costs if we go into production at 5M tokens/month.
3) Timeline: procurement is aiming to finish the bakeoff + decision by end of July. We need a signed trial agreement and a procurement-friendly quote for our finance team.

If you can send a short proposal (one page) and a trial agreement stub by COB Monday that would help.

Thanks — Ethan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@brightsupply.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: BrightSupply — proposed save & trial package

Ethan — looping in a compact proposal and short-term save package to address the procurement constraints you called out. High level:  

- Trial: 2-week dedicated reserved pool (8xA100 equivalent), full support from our SRE team during business hours, and a one-time setup assistance package.
- SLA commitment for the trial: best-effort 250ms p95 with a documented test harness and runbook; if we fail to meet agreed runbook specs during the first week we commit an additional week of trial at no charge.
- Commercial: 20% list discount for the first 6 months post-trial if BrightSupply selects Redwood for production. We will include a production quote at standard list with the discount applied and an itemized TCO pro forma for 5M tokens/month.
- Security/compliance: Neha will confirm the required data handling notes for the trial; we can sign an interim NDA or addendum if needed.

Action items from our side:
- Provide one-page trial proposal + trial agreement stub (Markus)
- Provide benchmark config + expected perf/cost estimates (Dylan)
- Neha to review security checklist and share any blockers

Ethan, if you agree we’ll prepare a procurement-ready DocuSign bundle (trial agreement + quote) and target a June 28 kickoff call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@brightsupply.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: BrightSupply — technical benchmark config and expected numbers

Ethan — quick technical note and the config we recommend for parity with your test plan. Summary:

- Model: Redwood-v2-quant (8-bit INT8 runtime paths)
- Pool: 8xA100-equivalent reserved nodes (dedicated)
- Load: 2k concurrent sessions, 256-token avg, synthetic run for 30 minutes per scenario
- Expected: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~220ms; peak memory and KV cache behaviour will vary by prompt locality.
- Cost estimate (trial-run only, infra amortized): expected incremental cost for the 2-week trial ~ $3.6k (infrastructure hours + SRE support). Production TCO estimate at 5M tokens/month (with the 20% discount): estimated $Y per month (I’ll include a line-item breakdown in the attached benchmark-config.yaml).

I’ve attached the benchmark-config.yaml with the exact run parameters and warmup steps. Please run this with your test corpus; we’ll mirror it from our side and share the raw run logs.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: benchmark-config.yaml (YAML)

Team — thanks, this is helpful and addresses most of our immediate questions. We’re happy to proceed with the two-week dedicated trial under the terms outlined (trial SLA target 250ms p95 with the extra-week credit if not met). Next steps for us:

- Please send a procurement-ready DocuSign bundle (trial agreement + one-page proposal + itemized quote) by end of day Friday.
- We’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff on June 28 at 10:00 AM PT (confirm if that works).
- Procurement will want the final cost line items for 5M tokens/month and the proposed discount applied.

If Redwood can get those documents to Priya and me now we’ll turn the trial paperwork quickly.

Appreciate the speed — Ethan
